definition: Policies, institutions, roles and controls that establish accountability for the quality, availability, protection, sharing and lifecycle management of data. Includes data governance frameworks, data councils, chief data officers, data owners and stewards, policies and standards, data quality, metadata, catalogues, lineage, master and reference data, retention and disposal, ethics, maturity assessments, compliance and performance monitoring. Excludes governance of an IT project without data responsibilities, broad digital strategies that merely mention data, database administration, cybersecurity governance limited to security risk, and statistical production methods without wider data-management governance.
